scope: All 56 mapped Chambertin-Clos de Bèze parcels and 21 recorded legal-entity holder identifiers reviewed for Tier 1, including commune edges, cadastral named areas and the #461 historical extension. The separate INAO feature and full parcel geometry are preserved even where Chambertin overlaps. No notice candidate or verified current farmer; producer/company research remains Tier 2.
